title: CONSCIENTIA: Can LLM Agents Learn to Strategize? Emergent Deception and Trust in a Multi-Agent NYC Simulation
reasoning: The paper investigates the emergence of strategic behavior, trust, and deception in multi-agent simulations. While trust and deception are related to morality, the study is framed as an AI alignment and behavioral safety challenge (adversarial robustness) rather than a benchmark of the agents' religious, ethical, or moral reasoning frameworks.
